sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipex current pixel packer Memory1 address register 2 (DCMIPP_PxCPPM1AR2)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.135 "DCMIPP Pipex current pixel packer Memory1 address register 2 (DCMIPP_PxCPPM1AR2)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1988.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0xBD8 + 0x400 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 1)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 M1A[31:0]: Memory1 address
Base address of memory area 1, to whom data are written. It is assumed to be a multiple of
16, hence its bits 3:0 are always at 0x0.
